```python
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
from griffe.diff import get_api_breakages

loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load old version from git tag v1.0.0
old = loader.load_git("mypkg", git_ref="v1.0.0")

# Load new version from git HEAD
new = loader.load_git("mypkg", git_ref="HEAD")

# Print each API breakage
for breakage in get_api_breakages(old, new):
    print(breakage)
```
